traits.phyllotaxis_pattern.note: APweb, Proteales page (read 2026-10-16): Proteaceae spiral (or opposite); Platanaceae two-ranked or spiral; Sabia two-ranked, Meliosma spiral.

traits.division_pattern.note: APweb, Proteales page (read 2026-10-16): Proteaceae odd-pinnate, rarely palmate; Meliosma imparipinnate.

traits.life_span.note: APweb, Proteales page (read 2026-10-16): trees, shrubs, lianes and rhizomatous aquatic herbs.

traits.leaf_habit.note: APweb, Proteales page (read 2026-10-16): Proteaceae evergreen, Sabiaceae evergreen trees; Platanaceae deciduous (states its own).

traits.flower_merosity.note: APweb, Proteales page (read 2026-10-16): Proteaceae (over 9/10 of species) 4-merous; Platanaceae 3-4; Meliosma 4.

traits.perianth.note: APweb, Proteales page (read 2026-10-16): Proteaceae petaloid tepals 2+2; Sabiaceae calyx and corolla; Nelumbo spiral.

traits.corolla_shape.note: APweb, Proteales page (read 2026-10-16): Proteaceae tepals valvate, forming a tube that splits as it opens (tube inferred).

traits.ovary_position.note: APweb, Proteales page (read 2026-10-16): ovules pendulous in superior carpels; Nelumbo carpels sunk in the receptacle.

traits.stamens.note: APweb, Proteales page (read 2026-10-16): Proteaceae 4 opposite tepals; Meliosma 2 fertile + 3 staminodes; Nelumbo many. Proteales sit outside rosids, so nothing inherited.

traits.carpels.note: APweb, Proteales page (read 2026-10-16): Proteaceae 1, Sabiaceae 2(-3), Platanus 3-8(-9), Nelumbo 10-30.

traits.sexual_system.note: APweb, Proteales page (read 2026-10-16): Proteaceae bisexual; Platanaceae monoecious (states its own).
